title: I haven’t even seen @Paddington on Broadway yet and I’m already emoti...
transcript: I would quite literally do anything for this bear. Just look at his face. Paddington the musical is officially coming to Broadway this spring after becoming a massive hit in London, winning multiple Olivier Awards, and most importantly, getting rave reviews from every single one of my friends who has seen it. I am absolutely desperate to see this show. First off because I just love Paddington. I loved the books as a kid, I love the movies and because I have to see this puppetry for myself. Truly, he is one of the most stunning theatrical creations I've ever seen, and I've only seen photos and videos. But The way that two performers bring Paddington to life is just stage magic. And then underneath the spectacle, Paddington at its heart is a story about belonging, about finding family, and choosing kindness and offering someone a home. It feels very relevant and something we all need to hear right now. Plus, the music and lyrics are by Tom Fletcher, who is from the band Mcfly and also a best selling children's author, which feels like the perfect combination for a score that needs to be playful, emotional and full of wonder. Paddington the musical begins previews at the Al Hirschfeld Theatre on March 30th, 2027. I know this because I already have tickets for first preview. So don't worry London New York will gladly look after your bear.
classificationReason: Creator explicitly states they have not yet seen the show ('I haven't even seen Paddington on Broadway yet') and discusses anticipation, the London production's awards, and friends' reactions. Paddington the Musical also does not appear on the provided show list.
